trails.name: Trail near Starosubkhangulovo (Южноуральская тропа - участок Бурзян)
trails.why: Additional branch of the South Ural trail: It connects to the main one on the Krak ridge, passes through the village of Uzyan, the ridge of the Big Chatak, the village of Upper Avzyan, the village of Old Subhangul, Mount Masim and the cave of Shulgan-Tash. It passes without tents.

trails.name: Trail near Kolomna (Озёры—Коломна)

trails.why: Tolbachik is a volcanic complex on the Kamchatka Peninsula in the far east of Russia. It consists of two volcanoes, Plosky Tolbachik and Ostry Tolbachik, which as the names suggest are respectively a flat-topped shield volcano and a peaked stratovolcano.
